card.text: The brighter of the two nearest brown dwarfs, 2 parsecs away: a failed star 35 times the mass of Jupiter.

sources.label: Bedin et al. 2024
sources.quote: individual component masses 35.4 ±0.2 Mj and 29.4±0.2 Mj

introduction.text: Luhman 16 A and B are the nearest brown dwarfs, found in 2013 only 2 parsecs away. They circle each other every 27 years.

shape.title: Sphere of the measured radius
shape.summary: A sphere at the published size in neutral gray. No picture of the surface is cast here.
